diagnosis.reason: Installed global meanings and decoded checked records contain adequate local empty-space composition but no substantive general minimalist photographic practice connecting reduction, form relationships, and image-wide treatment. Broader semantic inventory also found luxury, fashion, grain and New Vision neighbors, none interchangeable. Baseline retrieval had not arrived at authoring time; a separate exposure contribution is unmeasured, so no ranking failure is claimed.

existing_candidates.meaning: minimal composition with generous negative space
existing_candidates.limitation: Complete decoded source is only a brief composition option; it does not describe a consistent aesthetic practice or color/form priorities.

existing_candidates.meaning: clear subject-to-field relation using one large low-detail negative-space region
existing_candidates.limitation: Strong subject/field relation already exists; repeating it alone would be a duplicate. Its effect is composition, not a complete Minimalist style.

existing_candidates.meaning: contemporary architectural luxury led by large material planes, precise junctions, sculptural volume, and restrained reflection
existing_candidates.limitation: Rich-material construction is a different visual system. An empty white interior is explicitly insufficient for its luxury claim.

Full source requires extreme viewpoint, structural diagonals, scale defamiliarization, graphic light/shadow, and real geometry; this is a different photographic practice.

sources.title: Adobe — Less is more: A guide to minimalist photography
sources.supports: Photographic simplification, considered subject/background relationships, geometric organization, and intentional color or black-and-white treatment.

sources.title: MoMA Learning — Minimalism
sources.supports: Historical Minimalism emphasizes simplified geometric objects and systems; the photographic adaptations here remain authored applications, not historical artifacts.

sources.title: MoMA — Serial Forms and Repetition
sources.supports: Seriality and repeated industrial forms as a distinct Minimalist organizing strategy.

sources.title: MoMA — Constructing Space
sources.supports: Relationships among simplified physical forms and surrounding space.

sources.title: Adobe — How negative space can help you use nothing to make something
sources.supports: A subject is defined by its surrounding image area; the area can retain texture rather than being a uniform blank.

confusion_boundaries: A lone empty region is a composition mechanism; a coherent Minimalist practice also controls what forms and relationships remain.
Minimalism can use strong deliberate color; neutral colors and achromatic output are alternatives, not universal prerequisites.
Historical nonrepresentational Minimalist objects and a photographic adaptation of reduction are distinct claims. These sources describe newly authored photographic adaptations.
Architectural luxury depends on material/construction priorities beyond sparseness; actual wealth, cost, geographic origin and brand identity cannot be inferred.
New Vision extreme viewpoints and scale defamiliarization are a different optional practice. Minimalist architectural geometry need not contain them.
Serial modules are one distinct option with count, setting and material effects; they are not an automatically compatible addition to a frozen single-object scene.
No minimalism recipe authorizes removing requester-required objects, people, context or locked colors.
Negative space can retain low-detail texture; an empty wall is not mandatory, and underexposure does not establish intentional reduction.
recommendations: Integrate candidates as discovery-only authored data, then perform exact unchanged-query before/after evaluation.
Review whole declared effects: object/setting/count, material, framing, lighting and color implications cannot be hidden inside a style-only effect.
Keep optional style candidates separate; do not combine the four recipes into a mandatory all-of scene.
Do not create native proof blobs or treat museum/software educational support as native source qualification.
Use held-out scenes with different objects and image structures to test generality.
